en: An old monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view over a town with low, tiled-roof houses and narrow streets. In the background, on a hill, stands a fortified citadel and minarets of mosques, indicating an Ottoman-era urban landscape. Printed captions in French and Latin script identify the place as Uskub, with additional Ottoman/Turkish script at the top. The card is worn and spotted with age and bears a website watermark at the bottom.
